scaledCalls: Every placement is SCALED from a plan symbol or a tag leader on ID-1.7 or A510.3 after fitting each sheet to the A100 frame; expect about 0.5 ft error. Where the two sheets disagree (washers, breakroom table) the ID-1.7 position is used because it is the FF&E designer's later sheet (07/04/2025) and the A510.3 value is quoted in the source string.

Fitness cardio and strength equipment: no cutsheets exist in the set (A701 keyed note 32 sends the buyer to fitness.hilton.com). Footprints are scaled from the ID-1.7 symbols; heights (treadmill 4.6, trainer 5.0, rack 2.6, bench 1.5, incline bench 3.5, ball rack 3.0) are assumed for massing and have no sheet source.
Which two ID-1.7 trainer symbols are the elliptical and which the recumbent cycle cannot be told apart; A510.3 lists both (804, 805) in a group note inside the room rather than placing them.

Laundry machines (401, 402, 406, 407, 409): footprints scaled from the ID-1.7 boxes; heights assumed (3.6, 4.5, 3.6, 3.6, 3.6 ft); no washer or dryer cutsheet was found on Drive by title or full text search.
Guest Laundry 024 room box scaled from the ID-1.7 walls because A100 only carries the label anchor.
Mirror 817 height 4.0 ft and television sizes are not on any sheet; used for massing only.
PA-310 towel station and PA-110 chair overall dimensions did not come through the spec text layer; scaled from the plan symbols.
Storage shelving 404 x3 along the laundry south wall: drawn 17.8 ft total, split into three 5.9 ft bays instead of the A906 6'-6" typical run.
Breakroom window and PA-402 shade position: no window tag on either plan; centered on the table.
gaps: No fitness equipment cutsheets or vendor list in the set; models, counts beyond what ID-1.7 draws, and heights are unknown. A510.3 legend also lists 808 strength system, 809 medicine balls, 810 exercise ball, 811 mat, 802 gym wipes, 812 rules sign, 814 emergency phone, 816 towel hook, 819 clock; ID-1.7 draws fewer symbols than that.

No commercial or coin operated washer or dryer cutsheets found on Drive (searched titles and full text for washer, dryer, laundry, Speed Queen, UniMac, washer extractor). Machine sizes are plan boxes only.
Folding tables, laundry carts and hampers for Laundry 015 are not drawn on ID-1.7 or A510.3; the laundry chute terminates in Laundry Discharge 013 (not in this kit).
A512 Enlarged Fitness and Laundry Plan and RCP exists only as a DWG on Drive (no PDF or text layer found), so it was not read.
A905 employee break room millwork and A701 elevations were not rendered; A701.md gives no mirror or TV mounting heights beyond 1'-6" and 4'-0" dimensions.
Keyed note 60 (accessible front load washer and dryer) placement conflict between Guest Laundry 024 and Laundry 015 (boh-admin.md D-3) is not resolved here.
The fitness room roller shades on ID-1.7 are all tagged PA-400 although the spec puts the framed window shades under PA-402.
